I largely agree about the danger, but as I was reading this, I couldn't help thinking about the staggering contradiction. At the opening ceremony of the Paris Olympics on July 26, 2024, a beheaded Marie-Antoinette appeared to the music of Gojira (a band I actually really like), accompanied by the revolutionary refrain “Ah! Ça ira, ça ira, ça ira, les aristocrates on les pendra” (“The aristocrats, we will hang them”). People all over the world watched the performance. thread_tweets.text: Alibaba's Panjiu 128 is not a true rack scale up. Panjiu 128 is made up of two 64 scale up size systems with ALink switch cartridges in the back. We covered this during our Alibaba Apsara Conference takeaways note where we found that only Panjiu 144, with switches in the middle of the rack, is a true rack-scale domain which is not due until 2028.
